blurb: Guests board the Sea Gypsy II pirate ship for an interactive 60-75 minute adventure including face painting, pirate lingo lessons, treasure hunts, water cannon battles, and hoisting sunken treasure. Birthday parties include private or shared ship options with party rooms and themed activities. Field trips and special events are also offered with educational and family-friendly experiences.
